tasks_completed.description: Added regression coverage for Codex subagent lifecycle call-id completion and app rendering matrix fallback summaries.
tasks_completed.changes: Added tests for spawn_agent/wait_agent/close_agent start/end visible call matching, fixture matrix IDs, image/screenshot crosswalks, generic fallback summaries, MCP empty states, request_user_input unavailable state, and subagent control content suppression.
tasks_completed.rationale: BA root cause identified renderer and mapper gaps; tests prove completed control cards no longer remain running and non-specialized tools no longer expose raw JSON as the primary inline output.

tasks_completed.description: Fixed Codex collab subagent control end mapping so completed control cards stop spinning.
tasks_completed.changes: collab_agent_call_end now ends the same visible call id that was started: spawn_agent ends the session subagent visible call, while wait_agent and close_agent end their own original calls.
tasks_completed.rationale: The previous mapper collapsed all subagent control ends through the session subagent mapping, leaving wait/close cards orphaned in running state.

tasks_completed.description: Implemented compact Codex generic fallback summaries and suppressed content blocks for subagent control cards.
tasks_completed.changes: Generic fallback now displays concise lines for Web, MCP resources, request_user_input unavailable, status/error/output, plus a details hint; subagent control cards render header/status only rather than blank/raw generic content.
tasks_completed.rationale: User saw raw JSON and overlapping/redundant main-flow content; primary inline rendering should be human-readable with raw payload moved to detail surfaces.

tasks_completed.description: Added knownTools crosswalk/status entries for image generation, Playwright screenshots, request input, and subagent lifecycle tools.
tasks_completed.changes: Added completed/error status extraction for subagent control and request_user_input tools; added mcp__playwright__browser_take_screenshot and image_gen.imagegen entries that reuse attachment summary and image preview rendering.
tasks_completed.rationale: Binding acceptance words explicitly called out image_gen.imagegen, mcp__playwright__.browser_take_screenshot, spawn_agent, wait_agent, close_agent, and request_user_input visibility.

tasks_completed.description: Expanded the dev Codex render fixture route into a deterministic tool-rendering matrix.
tasks_completed.changes: Added matrix metadata and fixtures for view_image, Playwright screenshot, image_gen, patch/diff, update_plan, parallel tools, subagent spawn/wait/close, request_user_input unavailable, Web search/weather, PTY write_stdin, MCP resource list/template/read, and unknown fallback. The route now displays user token to renderer key crosswalk rows.
tasks_completed.rationale: QA needs a stable dev-only route to verify every requested tool family in the same UI surfaces used by real sessions.

tasks_completed.rationale: The spec-driven workflow requires current-cycle implementation traceability before final response.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: N/A - BA identified current L4 renderer/mapper coverage gaps rather than a single blame commit.
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Codex tool envelopes and app renderers did not have a complete matrix for non-text tools; subagent control end events were not matched to the visible start call ids; generic fallback rendered raw JSON instead of concise user-facing summaries.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: The mapper now emits matching visible start/end ids, knownTools classifies requested tool names with correct status/preview behavior, generic fallback summarizes without raw JSON main-flow noise, and dev fixtures/tests cover the requested matrix.

diff_stats.justification_for_overage: BA scope required a full deterministic rendering matrix, regression tests, and cross-layer mapper/app fixture coverage for many tool families. Counts are scoped to implementation code files; existing untracked fixture/helper files are counted by full file length because they are not yet tracked by git.
